source.headline: Trump: US is the only one that has control of Hormuz

US2Y.source: latest U.S. close before Labor Day holiday

US10Y.source: Yahoo Finance reference via Arcane Intel

VIX.source: Yahoo Finance reference via Arcane Intel

learning_v2.note: No ACTIONABLE context-aware segment warrants a material confidence adjustment. The headline is treated cautiously because current oil prices still retain a large escalation premium and the control claim is not independently confirmed in the FF item.

predictions.mechanism: A U.S. claim of control and completed minesweeping could reduce shipping-risk premia if credible, but it also highlights direct military control of the Strait while oil remains near six-week highs; the immediate implication is two-sided headline volatility rather than a clean directional signal.
predictions.invalidation: Independent evidence clearly confirms either normalized safe shipping, producing durable de-escalation, or renewed direct conflict that creates an unambiguous safe-haven impulse.

predictions.mechanism: European equities would benefit from credible normalization of Hormuz shipping, but crude remains elevated and the statement may represent contested military escalation rather than genuine de-escalation.
predictions.invalidation: Brent falls sharply on confirmed shipping normalization or rises decisively on renewed clashes, creating a clear directional energy shock.

predictions.mechanism: The euro-area index has potential upside from lower shipping risk but downside from continued high oil and geopolitical uncertainty, leaving the net impulse balanced pending confirmation.
predictions.invalidation: A verified change in tanker traffic and oil prices resolves the ambiguity decisively.

predictions.mechanism: Japan is highly sensitive to Gulf energy security, but the unconfirmed U.S. control claim competes with still-high oil and yen-related forces, so conviction is low.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and tanker-flow data confirm either meaningful de-escalation or a renewed supply shock.
